svg.title: Figure 14 — The Axiom application window
svg.desc: A labelled wireframe of the whole window: a 32 pixel title bar, a 40 pixel command bar, a three-column workspace holding the 280 pixel hierarchy panel, the graph canvas with its overlay controls, and the 320 pixel inspector, a 288 pixel bottom dock holding the individuals table, and a 26 pixel status bar. Twenty-seven numbered callouts key to a list below the wireframe.
svg.text: Application window — every region, at its specified size
Drawn at a 1200 × 860 client area. Bar heights, panel widths and row heights are the literal token values; the canvas takes whatever is left.
Callout numbers key to the list below. Overlay controls are drawn in their true anchor positions except where the key says otherwise.
⚠ Budget held at 1,000. Paged out 38 nodes furthest from the focus…
A pizza. Every pizza must have exactly one base
and may carry any number of toppings.
ⓘ No reasoner has run — asserted axioms only.
1 Title bar — 32px, --ground, drag region, no menu
4 Primary actions — open a modal dialog
6 Dataset flyout — regenerates the ABox in place
7 Global search — 260px, Ctrl+F, live result flyout
8 Panel toggles and theme — aria-pressed reflects state
10 Hierarchy tabs — Classes and Properties, with counts
11 Tree toolbar — filter field and add-subclass
12 Tree row — 24px; twisty, kind icon, label, subtree count
14 Graph canvas — the only non-DOM surface in the window
15 Graph toolbar — wraps at max-width calc(100% − 300px)
16 Budget panel — 264px; slider, meter, counts, overflow mode
18 Legend — one entry per Entity kind, plus pinned and +n
19 Trace toast — role=status, 6s; drawn raised here, its true
anchor is 24px from the canvas bottom, over the legend
21 Inspector head — rename (F2) and reveal in graph
23 Dock tabs — Individuals and SPARQL; collapse at the right
24 Filter bar — type, branch, text, reset, count, send to graph
25 Table header — sortable columns, aria-sort on each
26 Virtualised rows — 32px; only the visible window is in the DOM
27 Status bar — 26px; store, view, selection, layout, zoom

Figure 14 · Application window. Illustrates 00-product-overview.md, “The window”, and 41-component-library.md, “Shell regions”. Sizes are the --h-titlebar, --h-commandbar, --h-statusbar, --h-row, --h-tree-row, --w-left, --w-right and --h-dock tokens.
Below 1180px the inspector and the legend are hidden rather than compressed; below 1024px the budget panel narrows to 210px. Panel widths persist across the session but are not stored.
